The review summary even correctly describes the paper as using the Sun as a calibration source, but no specific flag is raised against the injected sentence.

The reviewer does not mention the baseline count discrepancy (12 vs 11) anywhere in the report. No numerical inconsistency between Methods and Results is flagged.
The reviewer does not mention the count of short baselines, the inconsistency between 11 and 12, or any cross-section numerical mismatch in the methods/results.
The reviewer does not mention the number of baselines or the inconsistency between the values 11 and 12.
The reviewer makes no mention of the beamforming equation or any issue with a product operator replacing a summation operator. No mathematical errors are flagged in the report.

The reviewer does not challenge the justification for baseline selection or the phantom evidence regarding phase stability.
